name: Satu Holdings Ltd.
summary: Satu Holdings Limited, founded in 2000 and based in Kwun Tong, Hong Kong, is an investment holding company that designs, develops, produces and trades homeware. Its products include Satu Brown home decorations and THIS IS FOR U home fragrances and aromatherapy goods. It sells to brand owners, licensees, supermarket chains, department stores and online, in Hong Kong and many countries across Europe, North America and Asia Pacific.
